Method of Attack: distribution of malware to automate theft of sensitive financial and personal information like banking credentials
infecting computers and harvesting login credentials from banks and financial institutions
infecting business computers with malicious software that captured passwords, account numbers, and other information to steal money from bank accounts
Discoverer: Treasury Department’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN)
Office of Cybersecurity and Critical Infrastructure Protection (OCCIP)
Impacted Systems: computers of banks and financial institutions in over 40 countries
business computers infected with Zeus malware
Indicators of Compromise: previously unreported Dridex malware indicators of compromise released by FinCEN and OCCIP
